items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels carted to locker room with apparent elbow injury; awkward bend noted by Rapoport.
items.why: In-game elbow; carted, potential disaster per Rap
items.implication: Major concern for ROS/Week 3; backup situation
items.opportunity: McLaurin/Deebo/Samuel still play but QB downgrade risk

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury, replaced by Tyson Bagent; scheduled for imaging Monday; walking under own power later.
items.why: In-game hamstring; Schefter/Rap confirm imaging + walking ok
items.implication: Monitor for Week 3; Bagent in short-term
items.opportunity: Bagent streamer potential; Moore/Odunze/Burden still viable but lower ceiling

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) is officially ACTIVE vs Raiders after optimism and flak jacket plans; practiced Friday and improved steadily.
items.why: Rapoport bullish tone + no WR elevation; Schefter/Berry confirm active
items.implication: Start as WR2; injury docks still apply per Levitan
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected vs weak Raiders secondary despite rib

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) is inactive today after not expected to play; led snaps Week 1.
items.implication: Sit; opens RB opportunity in Denver backfield
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for backups (Coleman look per Levitan/Berry)

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck) ruled OUT; later update has feeling/movement in extremities, overnight observation.
items.why: Neck injury in game; Rap ruled out, Schefter positive extremities note
items.implication: Sit rest of day; monitor severity for ROS

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return today.
items.implication: Monitor return; handcuff ready if exits

items.text: McConkey ACTIVE confirmed; Harvey inactive—grab Jonah Coleman now. Agrees Bernard stash (YAC man, good McCarthy fit) with Pittman out; Sarratt also deep stash with Flowers/Lane issues.
items.why: Preseason ignore on Coleman; Bernard YAC/McCarthy scheme fit; Flowers opens Sarratt
items.implication: Add Coleman/Bernard in deeper leagues; confirm McConkey start

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) is ACTIVE/expected to play vs Ravens; clean bill per analysts.
items.why: Schefter expected; Rap corroborates with Young; Levitan no docks
items.opportunity: Full target share, no injury limitation

items.text: Dolphins QB Tua Tagovailoa inactive; listed among Sunday actives/inactives.
items.implication: Backup QB start; Waddle/Achane still playable but ceiling cut

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) is officially ACTIVE and will play vs Texans after questionable tag.
items.why: Coach/Taylor trending positive; Rap/Schefter confirm will play/active

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Week 2.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Texans pass-catchers

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; Rap tone bullish, official status late; Puka true GTD; Olave clean no docks; Harvey->Coleman look; Pittman->Bernard look. Projections updating for main slate.
items.why: Injury docks applied selectively; bullish Rap on McConkey; opportunity in absences
items.implication: McConkey start with caution; fade/avoid pure GTD Puka without pivot; stash Coleman/Bernard
items.opportunity: Coleman RB snaps; Bernard YAC/routes with Pittman out

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) is OUT; downgraded Saturday, confirmed in weekend summary and inactives.
items.implication: Sit entirely; Bateman primary beneficiary for targets
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman routes/targets bump; deeper WRs/stashes like Sarratt

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) is OUT per weekend reports and inactives.
items.opportunity: Germie Bernard stash/look (YAC fit with McCarthy per Berry/Levitan)

items.text: ETR weekend summary: GTD McConkey (optimism+flak)/Nacua; not expected Harvey; expected Olave/Burrow/McMillan (snap count); OUT Flowers/Pittman. Last-minute LS scheduled.
items.why: Aggregated weekend reports for Sunday windows
items.implication: Core status board for lineup locks; monitor LS for changes
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries as noted in Levitan follow-up

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) is a true pregame/game-time decision for MNF vs Giants; no practice, trending uncertain.
items.why: Hip (different from prior); Schefter pregame decision; Levitan true GTD; backup Whittington doubtful
items.implication: Have pivot ready; monitor warmups closely
items.opportunity: If OUT: TE heavy (Ferguson/Parkinson) + Konata Mumpfield/Malachi Fields bump

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee) doubtful and effectively OUT (elevations made; could return next week per Rap).
items.why: Knee; Myarick elevated; Rap next-week possible
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer targets/routes surge (team-high prior week)

items.text: Jalen McMillan (knee) expected to play/active, reportedly on snap count.
items.why: Knee; snap count limit noted; Schefter active list
items.opportunity: Limited snaps but still targets if featured
